name: TGPSC Group-I Services
summary: Telangana's top state service exam: Deputy Collector, DSP, Commercial Tax Officer, MPDO, Municipal Commissioner and more. Objective Prelims, then six descriptive Main papers plus qualifying English (900 marks). There is no interview.

status.note: The last cycle (Notification 02/2024, 563 posts) finished its exams in 2024. The High Court division bench upheld the results in February 2026 and the Supreme Court rejected the challenges on 2 April 2026. A new Group-I notification had not appeared on the TGPSC site by October 2026.

posts.name: Deputy Collector
posts.responsibilities: Revenue Divisional Officer; path to IAS by conferment.

posts.name: Assistant Audit Officer / Assistant Treasury Officer
Regional Transport Officer, District Panchayat Officer, District Registrar, Asst. Commissioner of Labour and others

age.summary: 18 to 46 for most posts; 21 to 35 for DSP, Assistant Excise Superintendent and some others; on 1 July of the notification year (2024 cycle).

eligibility.domicile: Local status (by study in Telangana under the Presidential Order 2018) decides eligibility for the 95% local quota in multi-zone posts.

education.summary: A bachelor's degree for most posts; specific degrees for some (see notification).

eligibility.physical: DSP and Excise posts have physical standards.
eligibility.examVsPost: Merit is drawn multi-zone wise; you give post and zone preferences.
eligibility.reservation: Telangana rules: SC 15% (sub-categorised into three groups under the 2025 SC rationalisation Act), ST 10%, BC 29% (A 7%, B 10%, C 1%, D 7%, E 4%), EWS 10%. Horizontal reservation for women (33 1/3%), PwBD, ex-servicemen and sportspersons. 95% of posts in local cadres are reserved for local candidates under the Presidential Order 2018.

eligibilityRules.notes: Police and excise posts close at 35. Figures from the 2024 cycle.

stages.name: Preliminary test (objective)
stages.notes: In English, Telugu and Urdu. 50 times the vacancies in each multi-zone are admitted to Mains.

stages.name: Main exam (descriptive)

papers.name: Paper II: History, Culture and Geography (India and Telangana)
Paper III: Indian Society, Constitution and Governance
Paper IV: Economy and Development (India and Telangana)
Paper V: Science, Technology and Data Interpretation
Paper VI: Telangana Movement and State Formation

stages.notes: Answer in English, Telugu or Urdu (one medium per paper).

selection.meritCalculation: Final merit = six Main papers (900). No interview. Minimum aggregate to qualify: 40% (OC, EWS, sportspersons), 35% (BC), 30% (SC, ST, PH).
selection.tieBreaking: Ties are broken by higher marks in specified papers, then age and date of qualification, as set out in the notification.
selection.probation: As per TS State and Subordinate Service Rules.

rankAndAllocation.text: Selection by Mains merit, multi-zone, community and local reservation, and post preferences.

salary.notes: Starting basic shown is Deputy Collector / DSP / CTO (58,850-1,37,050).

career.promotionNotes: State civil service officers can be appointed to IAS through the UPSC select list after long service.

benefits.detail: HRA or quarters, Employees Health Scheme, leave and LTC as per Telangana rules.

difficulty.rationale: Six descriptive papers with heavy Telangana content; very large applicant pool.

ratings.rationale: Top state posts, but notifications are irregular and often litigated.

factors.note: Group notifications come every few years.
The 2022 Group-I was cancelled after a paper leak; the 2024 Group-I was litigated until the Supreme Court in April 2026.

sections.title: How TS Group-I works
paragraphs: Prelims (150 objective marks) shortlists 50 per vacancy in each multi-zone. Mains has a qualifying English paper and six 150-mark descriptive papers, including one devoted to the Telangana movement and state formation. Rank is the Mains total; there is no interview.
bullets: You can write each Mains paper in English, Telugu or Urdu, but not mix languages within a paper.
Local status under the 2018 Presidential Order matters for the 95% local quota.
